rationale: This is clearly an auto collision claim: motor vehicle damage (totaled car) and injury arising directly from a motor vehicle accident.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was totaled in a rear-end collision on Route 9 at 8:15am yesterday; the other driver was traveling ~35 mph with no braking. Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information included. Vehicle damage well exceeds policy limits and warrants immediate adjuster attention.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info on report

rationale: Tree from policyholder's own property fell on their parked vehicle causing damage to hood and windshield; covered under auto comprehensive policy.
claim_summary: Policyholder Riley Kim's maple tree fell from their own front yard onto their parked car during high winds, damaging the hood and windshield. Estimated damage $3,000–$8,000. Auto comprehensive claim under POL-1005 with $1,000 deductible.

case_facts.description: maple tree from own property came down in wind and fell on parked car
